verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any in-product AI that generates insights or suggestions from the user's data. The MCP server ([docs-59], [docs-60]) only lets external AI clients like Cursor or Claude Code manage flags in natural language, so the AI runs outside LaunchDarkly. The other nearby items are adjacent features rather than AI-generated insights: AI Configs and LLM-as-a-judge evals for the customer's own AI apps, Bayesian highlighting of the leading experiment variation, rule-based stale-flag analytics, and vague 'self-optimizing' homepage marketing.
